country: Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Guyana, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

title: Provision of 3D Laser Scanning and As-Built BIM Services (Framework Agreement - Laser Scanning)

title: Architectural Technologist for Advanced BIM Modeling and CD Documentation
scope_summary: Seeking an experienced Architectural Technologist to collaborate on various architectural projects, focusing on creating comprehensive design and construction documentation using advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) principles and practices. The role involves developing and maintaining 3D architectural BIM models, translating design inputs into construction-ready models, and producing plans, sections, elevations, schedules, and details for construction sets.
